what: Section title ribbon — the round badge on the left spins in at rotateY 810° and 2x scale, settling in .8s expo.out. After .4s the badge and band slide in from 150px on the right (badge .8s · band 1s) while the text inside the band is pushed in backwards from the left by its own width and revealed inside a window

options.shift: Distance in px the badge and band are pushed in, default 150 — the original Product title uses 308
options.lag: When the band leaves after the badge bump (seconds), default .4
options.--fx-band · --fx-band-ink · --fx-band-h: Band color · text color · height · length hidden under the badge
options.[data-fx-part=spin]: Image rotating inside the badge (if none, the whole badge rotates)
options.[data-fx-part=band] · [data-fx-part=band: Band window and the text panel inside it (required)

use: IconYour title here
